title: CLI: tk tell --format/--file, tk ask --photo --gate
description:
CLI surface — cmd/tk/cmd/{tell,ask}.go + registration/ResetFlags; no interface or transport changes (consume x72/r6d as-is).

- tk tell --format: treat the text (args or stdin) as MarkdownLite and route through SendFormatted when the channel supports it (capability probe); without support, strip markup and fall back to plain Send with a stderr note. Plain tell unchanged.
- tk tell --file <path> [--caption "..."]: SendAttachment KindAuto (respect --as photo|document override). Mutually exclusive with --format. Unconfigured: exit 4, zero HTTP (existing contract).
- tk ask <tick> --photo <path> --gate approve [--caption]: gated attachment via the engine hook from x72 — parks awaiting approval, delivers photo+buttons, blocks/resolves/edits exactly like a text gate (all existing flags --timeout/--async/--escalate-after compose). --photo without --gate is a usage error in this epic (open questions on photos deferred).
- ResetFlags entries for every new flag var; both dispatch layers already list tell/ask (verify, no main.go change expected).

Test cases (fakebot + temp repo): formatted tell arrives with markup intact and plain path byte-identical to before; --file photo and document routing + caption; unsupported-capability fallback (FakeChannel minus the optional interfaces); photo gate end-to-end: tap resolves verdict with human provenance and the caption edit; flag exclusivity and usage errors; unconfigured exit 4 for both new paths.
Run: go test -short -count=1 ./internal/operator/... ./cmd/tk/...
acceptance_criteria: CLI tests pass incl photo-gate end-to-end and capability fallback; plain-text paths byte-identical; exit-code contracts preserved
